sloka: अर्थसिद्ध्यै हरिश्रेष्ठ गच्छ सौम्य यथासुखम् ।समानयस्व वैदेहीं राघवेण महात्मना ॥५-१-१७१॥
transliteration: arthasiddhyai hariśreṣṭha gaccha saumya yathāsukham ।samānayasva vaidehīṁ rāghaveṇa mahātmanā ॥5-1-171॥

translations.english: "O noble vanara proceed happily to achieve your purpose. Go and unite Vaidehi with the noble self, Raghava.
